text: Hushed bedtime music box and soft celesta, sleepy and magical night, a sense of wonder, gentle and quiet, then a sudden dramatic orchestral hit
Quirky upbeat comedic cartoon chaos: bouncy pizzicato strings, plucky bass, tuba stabs, snappy drums and claps, playful and fast, constant momentum
Abrupt stop into an ominous low synth drone with a slow heartbeat kick and a tense high string note, suspenseful and dark
Comedic chaos returns even faster: frantic bouncy brass, xylophone runs, slapstick drums, hurried and silly, constant drive
Slow motion: delicate tiptoe pizzicato and a soft music box over warm strings, calm, gentle and tender, ending on a lazy, resolved, sleepy chord
